visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a macro close-up of several sleek, aerodynamic metallic car models in gold and silver, resting on a dark grey base with engraved years like 2008 and 2012. (2) A man wearing glasses and a white long-sleeved sweatshirt stands behind a long stainless steel counter in a modern, well-lit studio environment, excitedly holding a large black rectangular box. (3) He points specifically to a small, embossed Tesla logo on the corner of the black box while smiling at the camera, with the studio lighting reflecting off the box's surface. (4) The man lifts the lid of the box to reveal a set of seven metallic car models arranged neatly in a row, gesturing towards them with open hands and an enthusiastic facial expression. (5) He picks up individual models, showing the 'MODEL S' engraving on the bottom of one and then demonstrating the movable gull-wing doors on a gold Model X model with his fingers. (6) He holds up a taller, silver model of a Tesla Semi truck and then a gold, sharp-angled Cybertruck model, turning it to show the 'Cybertruck' text on the underside. (7) Finally, he places the models on the counter next to miniature replicas of a Tesla Supercharger and a wall connector, leaning back and smiling with a sense of satisfaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narrator speaking over an upbeat, acoustic-led pop BGM featuring guitar and steady drums. A brief whoosh SFX highlights the initial scene transitions. (2) As the unboxing starts, soft sounds of plastic rustling and a mechanical click of the box lid are clearly audible. The narrator's voice remains bright and enthusiastic throughout the process. (3) A sudden burst of laughter from a second male voice occurs when a joke about the price is made, accompanied by a sharp 'ding' bell SFX to mark the comedic beat. (4) During the detailed showing of the Model X, a distinct metallic click is heard when its miniature gull-wing doors are opened. The background music maintains its constant, cheerful tempo. (5) The narrator concludes with a triumphant tone, summarizing the value of the set as the music and speech fade out quickly in a final hard cut.
